question: Can frozen three-task outputs be exposed with exact-date, calibration and identity gates?
selection: cohort equals method; F full-price cohort and FD diffusion-complete cohort; no claim of paired equal-universe comparison
source: R02 L2/L3 and R16 L1 formal predictions only, no raw diagnostic classifiers
universe: SW2021 full catalogue; model identities outside catalogue quarantined
time: current output requires exact observation date; previous output retained in distinct last_prediction fields with age, never substituted into current field
calibration: return is expected relative return, not probability; binary output requires frozen Platt parameters and qualified fold; calibration procedure does not establish forward reliability
missing: retain absent model/fold, skipped reason, missing feature and task ineligibility separately; no zero fill
validation: value equality to frozen sources, source/model hash, fit and calibration maturity before year boundary, full task grid, no target columns, no stale current values
scope: historical display integration only; no retraining, outcomes, thresholds, deployment or external collection
